definitions.gloss: contrail; vapor trail (left by an aircraft)
definitions.explanation: The white trail of condensed water vapor that forms behind a high-flying aircraft. Literally {飛行機|ひこうき} (airplane) + {雲|くも} (cloud).

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a contrail in the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{青空|あおぞら}→青空：10084_aozora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びて→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧いく。
examples.english: A white contrail stretches across the blue sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交差|こうさ}して→交差する：21984_kousasuru⟧、⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦バツ→バツ：00012_batsu⟧{印|じるし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: Two contrails crossed, drawing a big X in the sky.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧ (airplane) + ⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧ (cloud), with rendaku changing くも to ぐも. Refers to the white vapor trail behind a jet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: a contrail forms
- {飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧: a contrail stretches out
- {飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: a contrail fades away
